about: Stage E2h staging for the virtual field observer (proposal; applied by the integrator, this branch never edits src/field). Four scorer corrections that make T-FOOD-10 (and the §18 'wake' and 'settle' readouts) follow janmaat2014's Methods, read in full (docs/staging/e2h-prereg.md §1–§3). Registered at 09:38 on 2 October 2026 before this stage's diagnosis was read; model values seen earlier are disclosed in e2h-targets.patch.json. Applying it changes the protocol hash and the T-FOOD-10 value of every saved run: protocolLog entry and new freeze by the integrator. The effect on R0 and S3, computed from simulation records with the same definitions, is in the prereg (§8).

source.method: 'A target female was followed from the point of waking until construction of an evening sleeping nest'; 'Astronomical sunrise times were retrieved from the website www.esrl.noaa.gov/gmd/grad/solcalc/sunrise.html'; 'We only analyzed data from days that followed complete observation days'; 'Breakfast was defined as the first food item eaten after waking up. Only mornings where breakfast consisted of fruit were considered (74% of all mornings)'; five adult females 'all with young offspring (<7 y)' during 'three fruit-scarce periods'.

changes.today: sunrise = the first point interval with the sun's centre above 0°, sunset the first below 0° (geometric, no refraction)
changes.proposed: sunrise and sunset at the sun's centre crossing −0.833° (NOAA's sunrise: upper limb with standard refraction), as janmaat2014 and scripts/rhythm-metrics.ts use
changes.effect: sunrise 3.5 min earlier in the quick window (derived); departures in those 3.5 min stop counting as before sunrise; §18 'wake' and 'settle' shift by the same amount

changes.today: a follow starts at the first point sample after 04:00 at which the focal is not in `nest` phase 2; a focal already out of its nest at 04:00 gets a 'departure' at 04:00
changes.proposed: record on the follow whether the focal was seen in its nest after 04:00 (a departure was observed); T-FOOD-10 and §18 'wake' use only follows with an observed departure
changes.effect: none on R0, S3 or B in quick mode (no such follow in 12 runs; prereg §8); a guard for stacks with night activity

changes.today: every follow of an adult focal of either sex, whatever the first food
changes.proposed: only follows whose focal is an adult female with a dependent offspring at the follow's start (lactating, or mother of a living offspring under 7 y: a new Follow field `mother`), and whose first food item (the first point sample with feed type fruit, ground food or meat; water and milk are not food items) is fruit
changes.effect: the row reads mothers' fruit-breakfast mornings, as the field

changes.where: src/field/metrics.ts:717–722 (T-FOOD-10); the day's habitat fruit index (env.fruitIndex) stored on the follow
changes.today: every day of the scored window
changes.proposed: only follows on days whose habitat fruit index is below its long-run mean (`fruitIndexAtMean`, 0.6); report n; the row is 'insufficient' when no scored day is fruit-scarce
changes.effect: in quick mode only seed 7's window counts (seed 48's index is 0.95 on every scored day; seed 7's mean 0.56, minimum 0.46, all 30 days below 0.6); the confirm seeds 21, 5 and 11 were not checked
